pattern: ようと～まいと / ようが～まいが
aliases: you to~mai to / you ga~mai ga
purpose: State that doing or not doing something makes no difference.
keywords: V volitional + と … V dictionary + まいと; V volitional + が … まいが
The fee is the same whether you participate or not.
We will start as planned whether he comes or not.
Whether you believe it or not, this is a fact.
formation: V volitional + と … V dictionary + まいと; V volitional + が … まいが
restrictions: For する, すまい and するまい occur; ichidan may use stem + まい.
mistake: The two clauses concern the positive and negative of the same action.
